name: Polymer Processing
summary: Covers how polymers are melted, shaped and solidified by extrusion, moulding and forming, and how processing affects properties.

topics.name: Heat transfer and melt flow in polymer processing
Extrusion: single- and twin-screw extruders, compounding and profile extrusion
Injection moulding: cycle, mould design, shrinkage and warpage
Processing of thermosets: reaction injection moulding and compression moulding
Fibre spinning: melt, wet and gel spinning (e.g. UHMWPE and aramid)
Orientation, residual stress and crystallinity induced by processing
